**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The MSA contains no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding Northwind. Clause 12.3 goes further than the playbook's preferred position by affirmatively confirming we may engage any supplier and have made no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment; clause 2.1 reinforces this with no minimum quantity or purchase commitment. The only exclusivity-flavoured restraint (12.4, barring Brightline from marketing a directly competing analytics service) runs in our favour, so it stays as drafted. Remaining "exclusive" hits in the document are unrelated (non-exclusive licence, non-exclusive remedies, exclusive jurisdiction).
